hypotheses: B smooth connected projective over C, E algebraic rank r>=2, lines convention.
W=P_B(E plus O), X=P_B(E), torus weights 0 and 1, lambda inverted.
Degree m>=1 orbit-cover root gerbe with BOTH endpoints marked; a=(lambda+q_m^*p_X)/m.

assertions.statement: e_T(N_2pt^vir)=m! a^m product_{k=0}^{m-1} P_E(-lambda+k a), where P_E(t)=sum_{i=0}^r q_m^*pi^*c_i(E)t^(r-i).

assertions.attribution: Existing Argus report Section 1 equation (1a), beyond the manuscript's explicit leg/gluing description.

assertions.statement: Gerbe pushforward factor 1/m is separate. Forgetting an endpoint divides its Euler class by a_F, hence multiplies the inverse-Euler contribution by a_F.
assertions.attribution: Existing report's geometric convention, not a new correction.

assertions.attribution: Existing verify.py/exact_certificate.json, freshly replayed in the finite-moments unit.

evidence_limits: No Lean definition or proof of the moving Euler class.
The only geometric coefficient checked computationally has m=1, r=2, trivial bundle and point base.
Node smoothing and matching factors are not included in the twice-pointed leg Euler formula.
The 1/m gerbe integration factor must not be inserted again into the Euler product.
